# Point OSD picture descriptors into the heap

A picture descriptor pointing into a patch code tail blanked the rest of the OM-3 menu.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Every picture the camera has shown points into the heap (0xa2...). OM-Emu draws from either address, so no emulator test catches this.

> **What happens:** The rest of the camera menu is blank.

**Symptoms:** [Wrong picture, screen or card file](index.md#wrong-output)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): A test build with a descriptor at 0x60f9... blanked the menu; heap descriptors work. Source: [OM-3 research notebook](../sources/om3.notes.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/androidfanman/caduceus-om3/blob/e32363a01aef5f0119e750f35bc96644e6d9b4eb/research/NOTES.md#issue-64-the-wheels-dial-label-names-the-page-2026-11-16-featuredial-label-per-page-camera-tested)**
